sn18.11:1.1: Evam me sutaṃ || ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || Atha kho āyasmā Rāhulo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantam Rāhulaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca || || Taṃ kim maññasi Rāhula || || Cakkhuṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || || Aniccam bhante || || Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukham vāti || || Dukkhaṃ bhante || || Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu tam samanupassituṃ Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti || || No hetam bhante || || Sotaṃ || Ghānam || Jivhā || Kāyo || Mano nicco va anicco vā ti || || Anicco bhante || Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā tam sukhaṃ vā ti || || Dukkham bhante || || Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu tam samanupassituṃ Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || || No hetam bhante || || Evam passaṃ Rāhula sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmim pi nibbindati || sotasmim pi || ghānasmim pi || jivhāya pi || kāyasmim pi || manasmim pi nibbindati || || Nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati || vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti || || Khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || Etena peyyālena dasasuttantā kātabbā || || Pathamaṃ ||
